app.name: Contract Expiry Notification Agent
app.tagline: Contract-lifecycle automation with a human in the loop.

home.heading: Foundation is being built
home.body: Ingestion, extraction, human review, channel selection and reminders are live in the API. Five screens read or act on this organisation's work: the contract list every per-contract route needs an id from, the review queue, channel decisions, escalations and the reminder queue. Administrators get a sixth for the accounts inside their organisation. Ingestion still needs a client.
home.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends every session of your account, including the ones you cannot see.
home.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the account an administrator created for you.
auth.tenantHint: The tenant slug, not the display name.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.offline: The API is not reachable. Is the backend running?

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Fields below the confidence threshold that a person has to decide before any reminder can be sent.
review.signInRequired: Sign in to see what is waiting for a person.
review.viewerNote: Your role can see the queue but not decide. Ask an operator or an admin to accept, reject or correct a field.
review.empty: Nothing is waiting for a person.
review.emptyHint: Every extracted field has been decided.
review.revealedNote: This access was written to the audit log.
review.editHint: A correction is an approval: the value is normalized for this field type and stored encrypted.
review.decidedBlocking: Recorded. {blocking} field(s) still block this contract.
review.conflict: Someone else decided this field first. The queue has been refreshed.
review.forbidden: Your role cannot decide a review.
review.offline: The API is not reachable. Is the backend running?
review.invalidValue: That value does not parse as this field's type.
review.failed: That did not work. Try again.

escalations.title: Escalation queue
escalations.subtitle: Contracts nobody has heard from, the one closest to its deadline first. Closing a row here closes the queue item, not the contract.
escalations.signInRequired: Sign in to see what is late.
escalations.contractInvalid: A contract id is a whole number above zero.
escalations.contractInvalidHint: The address names something that cannot be a contract, so no queue is shown. Showing every contract behind a filter that never ran would answer a question nobody asked.
escalations.viewerNote: Your role can read this queue but not work it. Ask an operator or an admin to claim or resolve a row.
escalations.nothingResolved: No resolved rows are in this view.
escalations.emptyForContract: Nothing is late for this contract.
escalations.emptyHint: No contract has run past its response window.
escalations.resolveHint: The contract stays escalated: nobody has heard from the customer. Resolve closes the queue item only.
escalations.replyHint: Records that they answered, and closes the open escalation. The reply itself is never sent to this API.
escalations.replyClosedEscalation: The open escalation was closed by that reply.
escalations.replyNoEscalation: No open escalation was attached to that contract.
escalations.conflict: Someone else changed this row first. The queue has been refreshed.
escalations.closedRefusal: This escalation is already resolved. Reload to see the queue as it is now.
escalations.invalidTransition: That is not a move this queue allows. sla_breached is derived from the deadline and cannot be set by hand.
escalations.forbidden: Your role cannot work this queue.
escalations.offline: The API is not reachable. Is the backend running?
escalations.failed: That did not work. Try again.

agent.title: Channel decisions
agent.subtitle: What the policy recommended for each contract, and the grounds it gave. A reminder is scheduled from a stored decision, so this is the last place to disagree with one before it sends.
agent.signInRequired: Sign in to see the decisions and who changed them.
agent.filterInvalid: A contract id is a whole number above zero.
agent.filterInvalidHint: The address names something that cannot be a contract, so no history is shown. Showing every decision behind a filter that never ran would answer a question nobody asked.
agent.viewerNote: Your role can read decisions but not change them. Ask an operator or an admin to re-run, override or flag one.
agent.empty: No decision has been stored yet.
agent.emptyForContract: This contract has no stored decision.
agent.emptyHint: The policy stores a row whenever a contract is decided.
agent.rerunDone: Policy re-run. The newest row above is what it says now.
agent.overriddenBadge: The policy said {from}; an operator chose {to}.
agent.overrideHint: Only a channel the customer consented to is accepted. A refusal names the ones that would work.
agent.reasonPlaceholder: Why this decision is being changed
agent.flagHint: A flagged recommendation never sends. The row stays in the history, with its reason.
agent.olderRowNote: An older recommendation. Corrections apply to the newest one for this contract, so they are not offered here.
agent.conflict: Someone else changed this row first. The list has been refreshed.
agent.noDecision: This contract has no current recommendation. Re-run the policy first.
agent.refusePipelineBlocked: This contract is blocked further back: a field is still waiting for a person. Decide it in the review queue first.
agent.refuseNoConsent: The customer consented to no channel at all, so there is nothing to recommend.
agent.refuseContactRefused: The customer opted out of contact. That is a stop, not a reminder to send later.
agent.refuseContractClosed: This contract is no longer active, so it cannot be decided again.
agent.refuseNoContactValue: No usable contact value is stored for this customer, so no channel can be chosen.
agent.refuseChannelNotPermitted: The customer did not consent to that channel; an override can only choose among the permitted ones.
agent.forbidden: Your role cannot change a decision.
agent.offline: The API is not reachable. Is the backend running?
agent.failed: That did not work. Try again.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.subtitle: Everything this organisation has ingested, newest first. This listing exists to find a contract the other screens take by id — it does not sort or filter by expiry, so "what expires next" is still not answerable here.
contracts.signInRequired: Sign in to see the contracts this organisation holds.
contracts.emptyHint: A contract appears here once it has been ingested.
contracts.offline: The API is not reachable. Is the backend running?
contracts.forbidden: Your role cannot read the contract list.
contracts.failed: That did not work. Try again.
contracts.ingestRefHint: The label this list shows in place of the customer's details — a reference code or initials.
contracts.ingestTimezoneHint: An IANA name such as Asia/Dhaka. Reminder milestones are measured on the contract's clock, not the reader's.
contracts.ingestDocumentHint: Attach the file and the original is encrypted and kept beside the contract. Without one, only the details on this form are stored.
contracts.ingestDatesHint: The dates are optional, and the server checks them: an end date before the start is refused.
contracts.ingestedNote: It is recorded and announced on the outbox. Extraction is a separate step, so it has no fields yet.
contracts.ingestViewerNote: Your role can read this list but not add to it. Adding a contract needs an operator or an admin.
contracts.ingestConflict: This organisation already holds that contract — the same details, or the same file.
contracts.ingestTooLarge: That file is larger than this server accepts.
contracts.ingestInvalid: The server refused those details: check the dates and the time zone.
contracts.ingestUnavailable: This server cannot store documents yet — no encryption key is configured.
contracts.consentNote: All four flags are saved together, because consent is stored as a state rather than as a change — a withdrawal is just a save with the flag off. Nobody is contacted unless a channel here is on and an approved contact value exists for it.
contracts.consentUnchanged: Already recorded — the stored flags already matched, so nothing was written.
contracts.consentViewerNote: Your role can read this contract's consent but not record it. Recording consent needs an operator or an admin.
contracts.consentConflict: Someone else recorded consent for this contract first. The flags now shown are the stored ones — check them and save again.
contracts.consentNotFound: That contract is not in this organisation.
contracts.detailNotFound: That contract is not in this organisation.
contracts.detailForbidden: Your role cannot read this contract.
contracts.detailConsentNote: Consent is recorded from the list, so one screen owns that write.
contracts.detailRelatedNote: Each read below asks its own route with this contract's id, so the numbers are this contract's. The links carry that same id, so each screen opens already filtered to this contract.
contracts.detailDecisionsCount: {count} decisions are recorded for this contract.
contracts.detailNotificationsCount: {count} reminders are scheduled for this contract.
contracts.detailEscalationsCount: {count} escalations are recorded for this contract.
contracts.detailEscalationOverdue: {count} of them are past their deadline (the SLA is {hours}h).
contracts.fieldsHint: Values are not shown here. Revealing one is an audited action on the review queue.
contracts.fieldsEmpty: Nothing has been extracted from this contract yet.
contracts.fieldsEmptyHint: Extraction is a separate step from ingestion, so a new contract carries no fields until it has run.
contracts.fieldsClear: No field is blocking this contract's reminders.
contracts.fieldsBlocking: {count} of these still block this contract's reminders.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Every reminder this organisation has scheduled, newest milestone first. This is a record of attempts, not of people: the screen never shows who a reminder reached.
notifications.signInRequired: Sign in to see the reminders this organisation has scheduled.
notifications.contractInvalid: A contract id is a whole number above zero.
notifications.contractInvalidHint: The address names something that cannot be a contract, so no queue is shown. Showing every reminder behind a filter that never ran would answer a question nobody asked.
notifications.viewerNote: Your role can see the queue but not act on it. Ask an operator or an admin to send or requeue a reminder.
notifications.recipientNote: Who a reminder reached is not shown here. Reading an approved contact value is the review screen's audited reveal.
notifications.emptyForContract: No reminder matches this contract and these filters.
notifications.emptyHint: A reminder appears here once one has been scheduled for a contract.
notifications.sendConfirmHint: This contacts the customer immediately, whatever the milestone date says.
notifications.sendAttemptFailed: The attempt failed and was recorded: {error}
notifications.sendDeferred: Deferred to {when} — outside the customer's contact window.
notifications.retrySucceeded: Requeued with a fresh retry budget.
notifications.refusalNotFailed: Only a failed or suppressed reminder is requeued.
notifications.refusalContractClosed: The contract is closed, so no reminder may be sent.
notifications.refusalContactRefused: The customer has asked not to be contacted.
notifications.refusalNoConsent: No channel consent is on record for this contract.
notifications.refusalPipelineBlocked: A field still needs a person to approve it, so the send is blocked.
notifications.refusalNotPending: This reminder has already left the pending state.
notifications.refusalNotYetDue: This milestone is not due yet.
notifications.refusalNotInWindow: It is outside the customer's contact window right now.
notifications.refusalMissingEndDate: The contract has no end date, so no milestone can be computed.
notifications.refusalUnknownTimezone: The contract's time zone is not recognised.
notifications.refusalNeedsReview: The agent decision is flagged for review, so nothing is sent from it.
notifications.refusalChannelNotConsented: The customer has not consented to this channel.
notifications.refusalAttemptsExhausted: The retry budget is spent. Requeue it before trying again.
notifications.refusalSenderUnavailable: No transport is configured, so nothing can be sent.
notifications.refusalRecipientUnavailable: No approved contact value exists for this channel.
notifications.refusalConcurrentUpdate: Someone else changed this reminder first. Reload.
notifications.offline: The API is not reachable. Is the backend running?
notifications.forbidden: Your role cannot act on reminders.
notifications.failed: That did not work. Try again.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: The accounts inside this organisation. Only an admin may read or change them, and a change here ends the target's sessions.
users.signInRequired: Sign in as an administrator to manage the accounts in this organisation.
users.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. The server decides, so a shorter one is refused.
users.sessionNote: Changing a role or deactivating an account ends that person's sessions: the role travels inside the token they already hold.
users.resetOnce: This is the only time this value is shown. There is no mail transport to send it again, so pass it on now.
users.empty: This organisation has one account: yours.
users.selfNote: This is your own account. The server refuses a change to it, so no controls are offered here.
users.resetConfirmHint: Their current password stops working immediately and their sessions end.
users.resetInactiveHint: A deactivated account cannot be given a new password. Reactivate it first.
users.offline: The API is not reachable. Is the backend running?
users.forbiddenHint: An administrator manages accounts. Your role can use the screens but not change who exists.
users.conflict: The server refused that change. It may be your own account, or a deactivated one.
users.notFound: That account no longer exists. Reload the list.
users.invalidInput: The server did not accept those details. Check the email and the password.
users.failed: That did not work. Try again.
